label: Theta.8 controls: heavenly first, contingent first, idle uncaused composite, checked
meaning: Controls for the Theta.8 routes. HeavenlyFirst: the Theta.8 substance premises leave a first being in potency to a place. ContingentFirst: 8288ff1e does not imply first-being incorruptibility. RestrictedStrict and Facts: the restricted composition premise is strictly weaker, and equivalent given STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING. IdleUncausedComposite: an interpretation satisfies every premise of the composition, Theta.8 and plenitude routes except the cause of composites and plenitude, with a composite, uncaused first being in potency to a place it never actualizes; so a rival who keeps a first being with an unactualized potency must reject at least the cause of composites (or a composition premise or first-being act) and at least one plenitude-route premise. ThetaEightOmissions and PlenitudeOmissions: each premise of both new routes is needed; the plenitude route has a nonvacuous witness. Model-witnessed and general implications only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
